Everyone's a genius holding $BTC and $ETH in a bull run.

Try holding through the pain of $SOL at $8, $DOGE when it was a joke, or $LINK doing nothing for 2 years.

Most of you don’t have conviction — you have FOMO.

That’s why you’ll sell too early. 

Again.

If you bought $DOGE because of a meme

$SHIB because of hype,

But ignored $LINK because “it’s boring” — congrats, you’ve misunderstood crypto entirely.
